It stays weak (below a quarter of max) on prepositions after lexical or motion verbs (sat on, crashed/rolled into, depends on, based on, click on, arrived at, talked about), after -ed/participle adjectives (interested in, filled with, known for, tired of), after nouns (capital of), on sentence-initial 'Only', and on by/from/about/over/through/between/near anywhere.
